scope: Pure safe-metadata helpers, actual config handler with mocked store/auth/features boundaries, and actual React notice/privacy static SSR. No remote database/network/provider calls; no durability, live deployment or device proof.
checks: Public metadata accepts only known modes with ready true and emits exactly two safe fields

Actual config handler emits remote-libsql from opened store, never endpoint or connection credentials
AI disabled still opens and checks database instead of short-circuiting readiness
Config open failure returns safe 503 without ready metadata or raw error
Config poisoned cached connection returns safe 503 without ready metadata or raw error
Config unknown actual mode returns safe 503 without ready metadata or raw error
Desktop and public demo bypasses retain previous disabled mode without opening a server database

Actual notice SSR retains local/default detail and shows separate remote storage disclosure in en

Actual notice SSR retains local/default detail and shows separate remote storage disclosure in ja
Actual notice SSR retains local/default detail and shows separate remote storage disclosure in ko
